readme:
# SmoothQuant 激活与权重等价平滑

## 1. 问题

计算逐输入通道平滑因子，并验证相反方向缩放保持线性层输出与梯度。

校准最大值、离线scale与可微等价变换；实验用对称INT8模拟量化，未实现整数GEMM或LayerNorm融合。

原文: [SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.10438) · Section 4, Equations (3) and (4); official smooth.py offline scale construction.

## 2. 核心公式

$$
s_j=\max\left(\frac{(\max_i|X_{ij}|)^\alpha}{\max(\max_o|W_{jo}|,\epsilon)^{1-\alpha}},\epsilon\right),\quad \widehat X=X/s,\quad \widehat W=sW,\quad \widehat X\widehat W=XW.
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

- `smooth_scales(x: Tensor, weight: Tensor, alpha: float = 0.5, eps: float = 1e-5) -> Tensor` — Detached positive per-input-channel calibration scales.
- `smooth_transform(x: Tensor, weight: Tensor, scales: Tensor) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]` — Differentiable reciprocally rescaled activations and weights.

在样本轴提取激活最大值，在输出轴提取权重最大值，二者得到同一个输入通道向量。激活除以scale，权重乘以scale。校准统计无需梯度，等价矩阵乘法仍保留训练梯度。

## 4. 本题约定

x:(N,D)，weight:(D,O)，alpha在[0,1]；eps>0。权重通道绝对最大值先clamp到eps，最终scale再clamp到eps；零激活通道按该公式处理。scale脱离校准图，smooth_transform仍对x、weight、scale可微。输入不修改。

## 5. 交互图

用 17 个样本、一个幅度100的离群通道及反向缩小的权重，扫描alpha；对比直接INT8与平滑后INT8的重建误差。

T3 使用实际待测函数生成实验，网页参考图使用参考实现。数值来自教学样本，不表示GPU吞吐或完整模型质量。

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

结合所引章节，解释本题保留了哪些维度、状态或调度约束，再扩展实验样本并保持已有契约。更大模型、真实设备与通信代价需要单独测量。

# SmoothQuant 激活与权重等价平滑 — 题解

## 推导与实现

在样本轴提取激活最大值，在输出轴提取权重最大值，二者得到同一个输入通道向量。激活除以scale，权重乘以scale。校准统计无需梯度，等价矩阵乘法仍保留训练梯度。

$$
s_j=\max\left(\frac{(\max_i|X_{ij}|)^\alpha}{\max(\max_o|W_{jo}|,\epsilon)^{1-\alpha}},\epsilon\right),\quad \widehat X=X/s,\quad \widehat W=sW,\quad \widehat X\widehat W=XW.
$$

## 边界与梯度归属

x:(N,D)，weight:(D,O)，alpha在[0,1]；eps>0。权重通道绝对最大值先clamp到eps，最终scale再clamp到eps；零激活通道按该公式处理。scale脱离校准图，smooth_transform仍对x、weight、scale可微。输入不修改。

## 独立检验

T0检查接口和无效边界。T1使用手算或独立标量公式。T2检查不变量、状态守恒、有意义的梯度或状态更新原子性。T3把待测实现传入确定性实验，不会导入两个相同参考实现互相比对。

## 行为实验

用 17 个样本、一个幅度100的离群通道及反向缩小的权重，扫描alpha；对比直接INT8与平滑后INT8的重建误差。

校准最大值、离线scale与可微等价变换；实验用对称INT8模拟量化，未实现整数GEMM或LayerNorm融合。

### 参考测量

确定性CPU样本；Python 3.14.2, PyTorch 2.14.1.

| Metric | Reference value |
| --- | ---: |
| unsmoothed_mse | 0.052506032 |
| balanced_mse | 2.6201785e-05 |
| equivalence_error | 3.3306691e-16 |

## 常见错误

- m1_weight_wrong_direction: 权重也除以scale破坏等价变换
- m2_mean_instead_of_max: 校准激活使用均值而非最大值

en.readme:
# SmoothQuant Equivalent Activation and Weight Smoothing

## 1. Problem

Compute input-channel smoothing factors and preserve linear-layer outputs and gradients under reciprocal scaling.

Calibration maxima, offline scales and differentiable equivalent transforms; the experiment simulates symmetric INT8 without integer GEMM or LayerNorm fusion.

Source: [SmoothQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.10438) · Section 4, Equations (3) and (4); official smooth.py offline scale construction.

## 2. Core equations

$$
s_j=\max\left(\frac{(\max_i|X_{ij}|)^\alpha}{\max(\max_o|W_{jo}|,\epsilon)^{1-\alpha}},\epsilon\right),\quad \widehat X=X/s,\quad \widehat W=sW,\quad \widehat X\widehat W=XW.
$$

## 3. From equations to code

- `smooth_scales(x: Tensor, weight: Tensor, alpha: float = 0.5, eps: float = 1e-5) -> Tensor` — Detached positive per-input-channel calibration scales.
- `smooth_transform(x: Tensor, weight: Tensor, scales: Tensor) -> tuple[Tensor, Tensor]` — Differentiable reciprocally rescaled activations and weights.

Reduce activation maxima over samples and weight maxima over output channels to obtain the same input-channel vector. Divide activations and multiply weights by that vector. Calibration statistics are detached while the equivalent matrix product preserves training gradients.

## 4. Conventions

x:(N,D), weight:(D,O), alpha in [0,1], eps>0. Clamp weight-channel absolute maxima to eps, then clamp final scales to eps. Zero activation channels follow this formula. Calibration scales are detached; smooth_transform is differentiable in x, weight and scale. Inputs are unchanged.

## 5. Experiment view

Use 17 samples with one activation channel amplified by 100 and correspondingly small weights; sweep alpha and compare direct and smoothed INT8 reconstruction errors.

The chart is generated by the actual submitted kernel during T3 and by the reference during export. Values are synthetic teaching measurements, not GPU throughput or full-model quality claims.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Further study

Read the cited section and explain which dimensions or scheduling constraints the kernel preserves. Then extend the experiment beyond the stated fixture while retaining the existing contract. Larger models, real devices, and communication costs require separate measurement.
en.notes:
# SmoothQuant Equivalent Activation and Weight Smoothing — Solution notes

## Derivation and implementation

Reduce activation maxima over samples and weight maxima over output channels to obtain the same input-channel vector. Divide activations and multiply weights by that vector. Calibration statistics are detached while the equivalent matrix product preserves training gradients.

$$
s_j=\max\left(\frac{(\max_i|X_{ij}|)^\alpha}{\max(\max_o|W_{jo}|,\epsilon)^{1-\alpha}},\epsilon\right),\quad \widehat X=X/s,\quad \widehat W=sW,\quad \widehat X\widehat W=XW.
$$

## Boundary and gradient ownership

x:(N,D), weight:(D,O), alpha in [0,1], eps>0. Clamp weight-channel absolute maxima to eps, then clamp final scales to eps. Zero activation channels follow this formula. Calibration scales are detached; smooth_transform is differentiable in x, weight and scale. Inputs are unchanged.

## Independent checks

T0 checks the callable contract and invalid boundaries. T1 uses hand calculations or an independent scalar formulation. T2 checks invariances, state conservation, gradients when meaningful, or atomic state changes. T3 invokes the supplied implementation in the deterministic experiment; it does not compare two imports of the same reference.

## Behavioral experiment

Use 17 samples with one activation channel amplified by 100 and correspondingly small weights; sweep alpha and compare direct and smoothed INT8 reconstruction errors.

Calibration maxima, offline scales and differentiable equivalent transforms; the experiment simulates symmetric INT8 without integer GEMM or LayerNorm fusion.

### Reference calibration

Deterministic CPU fixture; Python 3.14.2, PyTorch 2.14.1.

| Metric | Reference value |
| --- | ---: |
| unsmoothed_mse | 0.052506032 |
| balanced_mse | 2.6201785e-05 |
| equivalence_error | 3.3306691e-16 |

## Common mistakes

- m1_weight_wrong_direction: Dividing both operands destroys the equivalent linear transform.
- m2_mean_instead_of_max: Mean statistics do not enforce the specified peak-activation scale.
